== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 7 January 2021. The Facebook photo viewer names Robert Silmser. Comments on the photograph name Mr and Mrs Silmser. Identification: distinctive name plus Gold 44 FL on the Decipher Squadron roster (Tampa, Fl). The Facebook profile is facebook.com/HisstKa (Riverview, Florida; married to Theresa Silmser). The uncropped original is a two-person photograph; the lead crop is Silmser alone.
Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Robert Silmser portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Robert Silmser Facebook portrait.jpg]].
